description: This file defines an interface FeaturePropertiesBuilder in Java, which provides a fluent API for building mutable FeatureProperties objects with various setter methods for different data types and JSON fields. It is part of a model for feature properties within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically for manipulating feature property data in a JSON-like structure.
